title: Remove Nodes From Linked List
goal: Remove every linked-list node that has a strictly larger value somewhere to its right.
strategy: Keep surviving nodes in nonincreasing order on a stack. A new larger node invalidates smaller tail candidates; reconnect the last surviving predecessor directly to the new node using original node identities.

edgeCases: Equal values remain because removal needs a strictly larger value
A descending list keeps every original node
An increasing list retains only the last node
